activation_offload.help: Auto creates bounded CPU storage for checkpointed layers; none disables offload, cpu enables it explicitly.

hub_dataset_repo_id.help: Prepare directly into this Hugging Face dataset repository using datasets.push_to_hub.

hub_model_repo_id.help: Stream complete checkpoints to this model repository as Git commits and resume its latest version.

hub_private.help: Visibility applied to the output Hub repository before uploading content.

hub_gated.help: Access approval applied to the output Hub repository before uploading content.

cut_chunk_size.help: Token rows per cut-loss call; 0 passes all supervised rows to its internal tiler.

data_buffer_budget_mib.help: Total data-stage allowance divided across tokenization, shuffle, packing and prefetch.

endprompt_prompts.default: This is the end of text, please pay attention here

gpu_memory_budget_gib.help: Optional GPU memory limit in GiB. Zero lets CUDA manage available GPU memory.

gradient_checkpointing.help: Auto selects an activation policy from the model configuration and execution pack; enabled always checkpoints, disabled retains activations.

remat_inner_checkpoint.help: Retain per-layer checkpoints inside remat groups. Disabling this avoids nested replay but retains more activations during each group's backward; groups of size 1 are unchanged.

learning_rate_end.help: Absolute final rate for linear/cosine decay; ignored by constant.

loss_token_budget.help: Maximum projected token rows per fused-loss tile; the cut backend uses its own tiling.

mlp_chunk_size.help: Flattened token rows per MLP tile; unset selects from each actual microbatch. Explicit 0 disables outer tiling.

mlp_cache_budget_gib.help: Saved LoRA MLP intermediates; unset uses the automatic execution policy, 0 disables caching. Positive budgets override the policy on resident layers.

num_train_epochs.help: Epoch horizon, ignored when max_steps is positive; epoch-driven streaming requires an integer.

param_dtype.help: Storage dtype of frozen base weights; precision_recipe controls trainable parameter storage.

precision_recipe.help: Stable uses FP32 trainable weights, gradients and Adam states; reference_bf16 stores them in BF16.

prefetch_batches.help: Bounded synchronous CPU batch lookahead; 0 disables lookahead.

processor_revision.help: Revision for an explicitly selected processor; the default processor reuses the model commit.

projection_chunk_size.help: Flattened token rows per projection tile; 0 uses an untiled base GEMM with bounded low-rank workspaces.

quantization.help: NF4 applies only to frozen decoder projection weights under LoRA.

remat_group_size.help: Layers per outer checkpoint group; inner layer checkpoints remain active.

save_optimizer_state.help: Include Adam state for exact continuation after interruption.

save_total_limit.help: Number of completed checkpoints to keep; 0 retains all.

total_batch_size.help: Input records or stored packed rows per logical batch; gradient_accumulation_steps combines logical batches per optimizer update. GPU packs are controlled by microbatch_token_budget.

use_wandb.help: Log training metrics to W&B and resume the run recorded in the checkpoint.

wandb_entity.help: W&B user or team; defaults to the SDK account setting, or the checkpoint's entity on resume.

wandb_run_name.help: Display name for a new W&B run; the checkpoint stores its identity for continuation.

warmup_steps.help: Warmup optimizer updates, independent of streaming record counts. Must fit a known update horizon; a one-update run skips warmup.

attention_cache_budget_gib.help: Saved FA2 forward outputs in trailing checkpointed layers; unset uses the automatic execution policy, 0 disables caching. Requires single-layer FA2 checkpointing.

microbatch_token_budget.help: Target tokens per GPU pack within each optimizer update. Compatible short packs can combine across accumulated input batches. Independent spans stay intact; oversized spans run alone. 0 preserves input grouping and optimizer update membership is unchanged.
